explication: This repository curates glTF sample models and provides a TypeScript utility to validate their metadata and generate catalog files. The main workflow is selecting model folders, checking metadata, assets, variants, and legal details, then producing listings, model indexes, and per-model README/license files. The README also describes a separate web browser with search, filtering, previews, and metadata inspection; its implementation is not in this tree. Edges reflect the CLI and sampled utility references; the web capability is documented, not traced to repository code.
